capacity_boundary: In-use standard racks across the province.
note: This is the closest-date direct provincial observation found. It is materially below the CAICT area-implied March estimate, so the disagreement is exposed rather than resolved by silently choosing one source.

capacity_boundary: In-use standard racks in computing centres across the province.
note: A later same-year observation. It is useful for showing growth and for checking plausibility, but it is not a March replacement.

capacity_boundary: Province-wide in-use standard racks; the source says the total exceeded 350,000.
note: The direct source supplies a lower bound, not a point estimate. The CAICT area-implied figure clears that bound.
This later direct observation is close to the CAICT area-implied March estimate and is retained as corroboration.

capacity_boundary: Province-wide in-use standard racks in MIIT's 2025 computing-power monitoring data.
note: A direct year-end observation from the national monitoring system. It is not substituted into the March distribution because China-wide rack capacity also grew substantially during 2025.
A direct year-end figure published on a Guangdong government site; the underlying provincial table is not linked.

capacity_boundary: Province-wide design capacity of in-use data centres, expressed as standard racks.
note: The boundary closely matches CAICT's definition and the direct value is close to the area-implied March 2025 estimate, but the observation is one quarter earlier.

capacity_boundary: Province-wide in-use standard racks; Hubei Data Bureau data reported as more than 210,000.
note: The source supplies a later lower bound rather than an exact count.

capacity_boundary: Standard racks built by the province's information and communications industry.
note: The official statistical bulletin is direct and precise, but its industry scope may omit non-telecom facilities and its date is later than the CAICT distribution.

capacity_boundary: Standard racks across key data centres described jointly as under construction and in operation.
note: This is a province-wide official result, but it covers key centres and combines construction and operation. It is therefore not the same population as CAICT's in-use design-rack total.

capacity_boundary: Province-wide standard racks; the source does not state whether the count is in-use design capacity, built capacity or installed capacity.
note: An official current total that is useful for order-of-magnitude checking, but the missing in-use boundary and later date prevent substitution.

capacity_boundary: Municipality-wide in-use data-centre standard racks, attributed to the Shanghai Communications Administration.
note: The boundary matches closely, but the observation precedes CAICT by 18 months and cannot measure the March 2025 stock directly.

capacity_boundary: Standard-rack scale across 59 data centres in Pudong.
note: A direct lower-level subtotal. It cannot replace or be added to the Shanghai provincial total.

capacity_boundary: Data-centre standard racks reported for the cluster; commissioned-versus-built wording is not explicit.
note: A major Inner Mongolia cluster subtotal. It is useful for triangulation but cannot replace the autonomous-region total.

capacity_boundary: Built racks; the same source separately reports 170,000 actually used racks.
note: A second Inner Mongolia cluster subtotal. The difference between built and actually used racks is retained in the boundary note.

capacity_boundary: Operational standard racks; the source separately reports 500,000 built racks and a 66% rack-up rate.
note: A year-end operating subtotal for one Inner Mongolia cluster. Together with Hohhot / Helinger it supports the scale of the autonomous-region estimate, but dates and possible boundary differences still prevent substitution.

capacity_boundary: Powered-on standard racks, not commissioned design racks.
note: A directly observed major-cluster subtotal already in the exclusion ledger; it remains useful as a lower-bound cross-check.
